archetypes.name: selector-routing
archetypes.rationale: Targets the central risk that the plan flips prose but leaves /implement routing ambiguous or inconsistent with selector evidence.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit the plan against skills/implement/SKILL.md and the listed harness files to verify the selector is truly prompt-side, that unset and empty values route to python, and that only literal bash preserves the legacy fenced invocation. Check whether the proposed wording, pre-Invoke guard, and --no-logs-commit argv addition are sufficient without accidentally modifying the bash contract or stale exit-routing prose. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: stale-reference-sweep
archetypes.rationale: Focuses on cross-document drift from an env-var default flip that can leave old soak/default-bash claims behind.
archetypes.prompt_body: Compare the planned file list and grep strategy against repo evidence for every live mention of LARCH_SHIP_PR_IMPL, Phase 7, soak, default bash, and not-wired language. Look for omitted documentation, comments, or runtime-facing skill text where stale prose would mislead implementers or operators after the default changes. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: operator-upgrade
archetypes.rationale: Reviews whether the plan makes the silent behavior change understandable and reversible for plugin consumers.
archetypes.prompt_body: Evaluate the proposed operator notice and configuration-doc changes for clarity around the next-upgrade behavior, the bash escape hatch, and unchanged Step 18 teardown semantics. Check whether the plan covers the practical experience of users who never set the env var and users who must pin legacy behavior during rollout. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
